ready.name: The eval worker in Firefox, started at load
ready.what: Firefox showed Evaluation timed out for answers the worker could give at once, when the page's thread was busy: the worker now starts at load, and a reply waiting in the queue is not timed out. Finding 8 on #2609.

ready.name: MapPiece keeps unchanged pieces
ready.what: A projector update away from the caret copied the whole program; now every piece with nothing changed under it stays the same object. 3.12 to 1.92 ms an update on a 2,000-let program (its benchmark).

ready.name: Incremental evaluation around a recursive let
ready.what: Fixes the free variables statics reports for a recursive let, so an expression with one inside (a module with a recursive member, a function with a recursive helper) is reused, not run again.
